name: set_overlays
description: Shows or hides the viewport overlays: annotation pins/notes (`annotations`) and pLDDT confidence coloring with its legend (`confidence`). Pass only the overlays to change.

annotations.description: Show 3D annotation pins, ribbon highlights and the notes panel.

confidence.description: Color by per-residue pLDDT and show the confidence legend. No-op for structures without confidence scores.
